description:
Let's bust some "untranslatable" myths! And remember: learning a language is easier when you practice real conversations. Preply connects you with 1-on-1 tutors. Get 50% off your first lesson with code "ROB50" here: https://preply.sjv.io/m4N6ND

The internet loves “untranslatable” words: hygge, saudade, lagom, mamihlapinatapai, and plenty more.  But do these words really mean what the listicles say they mean? Are they even real?

In this video, let's fact-check some of the world’s most famous supposedly untranslatable words, from Swedish and German to Malay, Dutch, Yaghan, French, Swahili and beyond.

Some turn out to be genuine linguistic gems; others are exaggerations, misunderstandings, or outright nonsense. Join me as we separate the beautiful from the bogus in another RobWords.
